subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork override the current explicit deny for OpenRouter music generation?
rationale: The configured option is already an explicit operator-controlled capability and defaults safely to false, but enabling it on only the music path changes a security boundary and leaves sibling OpenRouter media paths inconsistent.

options.title: Honor the explicit option
options.body: Allow the sanitized model-provider request policy to control private-network access for music, then track or resolve sibling OpenRouter media consistency separately.

options.title: Keep music private-network denied
options.body: Forward the sanitized request policy while retaining allowPrivateNetwork: false so headers, proxy, auth, and TLS work without changing the current network boundary.

options.title: Standardize all media paths first
options.body: Pause this PR until OpenRouter image, video, music, and speech have one documented and tested private-network policy.

recommendation.title: Honor the explicit option
recommendation.body: Allow the sanitized model-provider request policy to control private-network access for music, then track or resolve sibling OpenRouter media consistency separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their provider transport-policy and OpenRouter routing work is the closest historical ownership signal for this precedence and SSRF-boundary decision.
